part: B5819W 40 V 1 A Schottky, SOD-123 (marking SL)
notes: Datasheet has no pin numbers: 'The marking bar indicates the cathode' and its drawing marks '-' at the bar end. KiCad D_SOD-123 pad 1 is the cathode (silkscreen closes at x = -2.36 by pad 1); Device:D_Schottky pin 1 = K.

Reverse leakage: the guaranteed figure is only <= 1 mA at VR = 40 V (25 C). The typical curve (p2) reads about 5 uA at 5 V and 25 C and about 60 uA at 75 C, consistent with design.py's 'about 5 uA at 25 C, 50 uA at 75 C' as typical values.

ratings.design: D5 reverse = VSYS-VBUS <= 4.2 V; D7 reverse = VSYS-VBAT <= 5.7 V
D5: system load about 0.5 A (0.75 A in validation plan); D7: <= 0.5 A for 1.5-3.3 ms at unplug
D5 plug-in inrush into the VSYS caps through R47: peak not quantified (UNKNOWN)

ratings.limit: 500 mW at 25 C, derated linearly to 0 at 125 C (p2)
ratings.design: D5 about 0.5 A x ~0.4 V = 0.2 W
typical about 0.35-0.4 V at 0.5 A (p2 curve)
